# Copilot instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) first.

- Building an app **with** OpenShell (a project with `openshell.json`): follow
  [docs/ai/app-development.md](../docs/ai/app-development.md) – the app contract (`PORT`, `127.0.0.1`, `/health`,
  `OPENSHELL_DATA_DIR`, relative `/api` URLs, capabilities) and the verification commands (`openshell status`,
  `openshell logs --errors`, `openshell call ...`).
- Working **on** OpenShell: see the project map, commands and conventions in AGENTS.md.
